## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: endorsements, renewal, license loss and the graduated license steps
Knowledge facts: part C holds 38 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 12 to 19; part C2 holds 24 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised August 2026 guide, the 25-question written test and the passing standard of 20 correct answers (80 percent) from physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 20; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MO-GDL-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-GDL-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-GDL-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the boater indicator charge (sec02-R18), renewal fees stated in reminder letters, office phone numbers and the donor, veteran and voter websites can change and must be refreshed from the Department of Revenue website.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E
